kjv: on the third day, and on the seventh day he shall be clean ... then the seventh day he shall not be clean
mine: on the third day and on the seventh day, and then he will be clean ... he will not become clean
note: The Masoretic accents group "on the third day and on the seventh day" with yithchatta (purify himself), so purification is required on both days; the KJV attaches the seventh day to the result clause.
Hebrew vechitte'o is Piel with an object suffix, "he shall purify him": the clean person completes the purification of the unclean one, who then washes.
